school-schedule.fixed: Automatic updates work again. Version 1.3.7 couldn’t install itself on most Macs, so this update brings everyone to the newest version.
school-schedule.added: Everything from 1.3.7, including your Schoology calendar: link it in Settings → Schoology and your homework shows up by itself.
school-schedule.notes:
Fixed: Automatic updates work again. Version 1.3.7 couldn’t install itself on most Macs, so this update brings everyone to the newest version.
Added: Everything from 1.3.7, including your Schoology calendar: link it in Settings → Schoology and your homework shows up by itself.

email-assistant.fixed: It now opens with a welcome card instead of Settings when you haven’t added an email yet.
email-assistant.added: On screen: open any email, even school email, and it reads that email and writes replies for you to copy and paste. Settings now say clearly that the daily summary works with personal email only.
email-assistant.notes:
Fixed: It now opens with a welcome card instead of Settings when you haven’t added an email yet.
Added: On screen: open any email, even school email, and it reads that email and writes replies for you to copy and paste. Settings now say clearly that the daily summary works with personal email only.

screen-assistant.fixed: Automatic updates are more reliable: they also check right after your Mac wakes up.
screen-assistant.added: If the app is running from your Downloads folder, it offers to move itself to Applications so it can keep updating.
screen-assistant.notes:
